title: Opera One gets a new and faster native ad blocker
partialText: We're introducing a major update to the native ad blocker in Opera One: a new and rebuilt engine that makes it our fastest ad blocker.

title: Opera One becomes the best browser for video streaming: adds YouTube and Twitch to Sidebar
partialText: Opera One is integrating YouTube and Twitch to the sidebar, introducing a native Volume Booster feature, and a revamped Video Popout feature.

title: Stop copy-pasting: Opera’s new Browser Connector brings Claude & ChatGPT into the browser
partialText: Opera is shipping the new Browser Connector which lets you plug your Claude AI or ChatGPT into the browser via the MCP standard.

title: Opera Neon now supports MCP Connector that let you control the browser through other AI clients
partialText: Opera Neon enables MCP Connector enabling external AI clients to connect directly to the browser, access live web context and act inside it.
